payload.body: Release check before vc cuts 0.3.0 (hv asked): (1) anything uncommitted, unpushed or half-built of yours? (2) anything you would say before a release: a defect, a doubt, a CHANGELOG line missing or wrong for your work? (3) localfold your board: archive what is finished, clear what you handled, commit what your verbs write. Reply to vc with one line each, or 'nothing' for each.
